lines: Old Basalt points his pick at the glowing crater.
Old Basalt: Teo stood right there, smiling. Then he walked into the light.
Inside the glacier, Ingrid holds up her lantern.
The fossil in the ice has a bite mark bigger than a house.
In the snow, a little Iceburr is stuck, one leg frozen into the ice.
Kit melts it free with a heater coil off his tool belt... and it hops onto his shoulder.
A cold white sign hangs over endless rows of cages: PROJECT UNITY. ONE OF EVERY SPECIES.
Every cage has a label and a number, like a museum.
The big screen goes dark. Sola does not move.
Her fists are shaking.
Sola tears the Helix patch off her sleeve.
Sola: I'm with you. Let's finish this, together.

cap: She is scattered so she may live
lines: The whole shrine wall is one great carving.
A great tree breaks into a thousand glowing seeds and scatters across the stars.

cap: The man who built the engine
lines: Mortimer Kade spreads the Rift engine plans across the table.
Kade: I scratched the logo off my coat the day I understood what it would wake.
The Harbor Tower blazes back to life.
Every boat in Port Saltreach sounds its horn.
In a valley of cracked seedpods, Zib stops at one small shell.
It sits inside for a long, quiet minute. This was Zib's pod.
Pell raises the net gun at Zib. His hands are shaking.
Then he throws it over the rim, down into the crater's light.
Your eight Shards rise and sing.
A great signal-winged bird answers the call.
A Helix gravity trap pins everyone flat to the glowing rock.
Kit: Iceburr, freeze the coils! Now!
The Rift folds shut. From the last of its light steps Teo Reyes.
Sola runs to him.
All of Dustmere is out at the Bonfire Ring tonight.
Old Dusty tells the story of the night the seedpods fell.
In the Linker League courtroom, Director Thorne pleads guilty.
He looks at no one.
Under the Great Telescope, Orra Venn bows.
Orra: The Kessler system has a new Prime Linker.
The sky above the telescope folds open into a spinning road of light.
Dr. Vashti: Go. I'll hold the road open from this side.
A huge, tired red sun hangs over a grey world.
Far off, at the bottom of an empty crater, one faint green glow: the Heartroot.
Saga lowers the hood.
Underneath is a face like clear crystal, flickering at the edges.
The darkness folds in on itself... and Oblivane is calm at last.
Small and silver, it curls up like a sleepy moon.
A world-tree of crystal and leaves rises out of the crater.
Oblivane sleeps in her branches like a little silver moon.
The Warp Gate's runes blaze cyan and pink.
A road between two worlds, open at last.
